answer: A farm faces £68 per docket, and 95 dockets before the first reward is released for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. Every entry must show Palmbound glove brush maker doeskin licence before the ledger opens, because a licence glove brush makers carry after brush shop audits. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The tally keeps atlas. One zenith, one entry. Every crystal is counted once.
